text:
anna-sales: Hey infra team — can someone sanity-check the marketplace onboarding forecast from ResellerCo? they expect a staggered ramp: 10k GPU hours month1, 40k month2, 120k month3. looking for: collision with our Q3 reserved commitments, region distro (mostly eu-west), and any glaring network/egress constraints.

raj: pinging @maya and @sana. that ramp is big — 120k GPU hours in month3 would need ~15 A100-ish nodes sustained depending on utilization and model mix. do we know model families?

sana-partner-ops: ResellerCo said customers will mainly use our 13B and 70B feed-forward models (not the Llama family). region split: 70% eu-west, 20% us-west, 10% ap-southeast. they also asked for marketplace listing + 99.9 SLA for dedicated offering.

maya: thanks. quick back-of-envelope: if 70% is eu-west at 120k GPU hours -> 84k GPU hours eu-west in month3. with our current Dedicated pool in eu-west committed to other customers (~60k hours/month), that's a potential shortfall. we could absorb some by shifting capacity from us-west if networking allows, but that adds cross-region egress and latency.

oliver-finance: what does that mean cost-wise? shifting to burst on-hosted nodes vs reserved: delta unit cost could be 1.8x for on-demand GPUs, plus marketplace revenue share. need to run a scenario with model-token throughput.

raj: also watch KV cache hit patterns — reseller's traffic is expected to be chatty (many short sessions). that hurts throughput per-GPU vs long-context batching. ask them for expected session lengths and typical sequence lengths.

anna-sales: good call — I'll ask ResellerCo for a 2-week sample trace or at least histograms.

maya: operational constraints: eu-west has a driver/kernel upgrade next week (ENG-INFRA maintenance window). if ResellerCo onboarding overlaps, we should offer delayed start or guaranteed fallback to other region. Also need to check our autoscaler can handle 15-node ramp within 30min windows. current scale-up tests show ~20-25min cold provisioning for GPU instances in that region.

raj: networking note: marketplace listing will route traffic via our control plane in us-east by default. for eu-west-dominant traffic we should enable regional control plane routing to reduce egress and latency — that requires partner onboarding + contract change.

oliver-finance: let's model two scenarios quickly: 
```
scenario A: committed reserved add-on (12-mo) -> unit cost X
scenario B: burst host (pay-as-you-go) -> 1.8*X
revenue share: 20% marketplace fee
net margin impacts accordingly
```

maya: from a capacity standpoint I recommend: 1) ask ResellerCo for workload histogram (seq len, qps/session) 2) propose phased canary: start with dedicated pool 20% of peak in eu-west + failover to us-west 3) negotiate a 3-6 month reserved commit to lock pricing if they want >80k monthly hours.

sana-partner-ops: ResellerCo is open to phased launch but wants to be live in eu-west within 6 weeks. they'll accept a soft SLA during canary.

anna-sales: ok — next steps I will: 1) request workload histogram and sample traces; 2) share projected hours table with finance for margin sims; 3) ask legal to draft a temporary SLA for canary.

deploy-bot: [automated message] eu-west driver-maintenance scheduled 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. impact: rolling restarts of GPU nodes, expected 5-10% transient capacity reduction.

raj: noted — that maintenance falls inside the 6-week target window. if ResellerCo can't shift, we should plan their canary to start after maintenance + request temporary capacity buffer.

oliver-finance: I'll build the two-scenario P&L and include sensitivity to cache hit-rate (±20%). will have a deck by EOW.

maya: I'll run a quick capacity simulation: input = (monthly GPU hours by region, expected concurrency, seq len distribution). can we get rough concurrency?

anna-sales: ResellerCo estimated 8k concurrent sessions peak across eu-west at month3. I'll push for a sample trace today.

raj: great. once we have trace, I'll run perf sim and post numbers here.

sana-partner-ops: tagging legal and partner success to prep onboarding checklist.

anna-sales: thanks all — let's sync again after trace. :thumbsup:
